goal.en: Connect compatible clients to GitHub Copilot and custom model upstreams through a local API proxy, with request analytics and live diagnostics.
goal.zh: 通过本机 API 代理将兼容客户端接入 GitHub Copilot 与自定义模型上游，并查看调用统计和实时诊断信息。

validation.result: Fresh git pull --ff-only succeeded on clean main in the isolated checkout. The unrelated original raven checkout was not modified.

bun install --frozen-lockfile passed with normal Husky. The locked npmmirror tarball stalled; retrieved the same gpt-tokenizer 4.0.0 archive from registry.npmjs.org, verified its exact SHA-512 against bun.lock, populated the missing Bun cache entry, then reran the unchanged frozen install. No lockfile, source, registry setting or hook change.

Root-reviewed deterministic cache-refresh tests and an app-test fetch fixture resolved the intermittent baseline failure and accidental live model-directory requests. Original assertions, product implementation, thresholds, baseline and hooks remain unchanged. Full normal coverage gate passes 1985 proxy tests plus scripts tests with lib/ 97.53%. Both the separate test-fix commit and README commit passed all normal pre-commit stages. Dashboard tests/build already passed against an owned unavailable local proxy endpoint. Normal pre-push also passed coverage, security, architecture and full lint. Remote CI completed successfully.

Real API tests use an actual proxy and its configuration/database. Browser tests isolate the database but still initialize GitHub credentials. These runners are not invoked for documentation validation and are not required by normal commit/push hooks.
All 14 local references per language resolve; Bash and dotenv blocks match. No 6DQ, test counts, coverage gates or hook governance in README.
GitHub homepage empty; no public site promoted. Root LICENSE is MIT.

publication.prePushPull: Fresh git pull --ff-only origin main succeeded; only the reviewed test-fix commit and README commit were ahead.
publication.remoteReadback: Both READMEs and both approved test files match local bytes through GitHub Contents API at main; clean synchronized main.
publication.hooks: Normal pre-commit passed for each of the separate test and README commits. Normal pre-push passed coverage, security, architecture and full lint. After git fetch --refetch --no-filter restored all reachable history objects, the unchanged normal gate:security passed again: OSV no vulnerabilities and gitleaks no secrets across the complete 1361-commit history; zero reachable missing objects. Log /tmp/readme-raven-security-complete.log.
